en.t: Pope Martin I, having been abducted by Byzantine authorities from Rome for his opposition to Monothelitism, is tried in Constantinople
en.s: Pope Martin I (Latin: Martinus I, Greek: Πάπας Μαρτῖνος; between 590 and 600 – 16 September 655), also known as Martin the Confessor, was the bishop of Rome from 21 July 649 to 653 or 654. He had served as Pope Theodore I's ambassador to Constantinople, and was elected to succeed him as pope. He was the only pope when Constantinople controlled the papacy whose election had not awaited imperial mandate.

zh.t: 教宗玛尔定一世遭拜占庭当局从罗马绑架，因反对一志论而被押往君士坦丁堡受审
zh.s: 教宗玛尔定一世（拉丁语：Martinus I；希腊语：Πάπας Μαρτῖνος；约590年至600年间出生，655年9月16日去世），也称“告解者玛尔定”，于649年7月21日至653年或654年间担任罗马主教。他曾作为教宗狄奥多一世的使节前往君士坦丁堡，之后当选接替狄奥多一世。他是君士坦丁堡控制教宗职位期间，唯一一位未经皇帝批准便当选的教宗。

en.t: Henry II of England is crowned at Westminster Abbey
en.s: Henry II ( (1133-March-05) (1189-July-06)5 March 1133 – 6 July 1189) was King of England from 1154 until his death in 1189. During his reign he controlled England, limited parts of Wales and Ireland, and much of France (including Normandy, Anjou, and Aquitaine), an area that was later called the Angevin Empire, and also held power over Scotland for a time and the Duchy of Brittany.

zh.t: 英格兰国王亨利二世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕
zh.s: 亨利二世（1133年3月5日—1189年7月6日）于1154年起担任英格兰国王，直至去世。在位期间，他控制着英格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰的部分地区，以及法国大片领土，包括诺曼底、安茹和阿基坦，这些领地后来被称为安茹帝国。他还曾一度控制苏格兰，并掌握布列塔尼公国。

en.s: Pope Clement III (Latin: Clemens III; 1130 – 20 March 1191), born Paolo Scolari, was the head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 19 December 1187 to his death in 1191. He ended the conflict between the Papacy and the city of Rome, by allowing the election of magistrates, which reinstalled the Papacy back in the city after a six-year exile.

zh.s: 教宗克勉三世（拉丁语：Clemens III；1130年—1191年3月20日），本名保罗·斯科拉里，自1187年12月19日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1191年去世。他允许选举罗马市政官员，结束了教廷与罗马城之间的冲突；教廷因此在流亡六年后重返罗马。

en.s: The Battle of Radcot Bridge was fought on 19 December 1387 at Radcot Bridge in England, a bridge over the River Thames now in Oxfordshire but then the boundary between Oxfordshire and Berkshire. It was fought between troops loyal to Richard II, led by court favourite Robert de Vere, and an army captained by Henry Bolingbroke, Earl of Derby.

zh.s: 拉德科特桥战役于1387年12月19日在英格兰拉德科特桥打响。桥梁横跨泰晤士河，现位于牛津郡，当时则处在牛津郡与伯克郡的交界处。交战双方是效忠理查二世、由宫廷宠臣罗伯特·德·维尔率领的部队，以及由德比伯爵亨利·博林布鲁克统率的军队。

en.t: Anne, Duchess of Brittany, is married to Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor by proxy
en.s: Maximilian I (22 March 1459 – 12 January 1519) was King of the Romans from 1486 and Holy Roman Emperor from 1508 until his death in 1519. He was never crowned by the Pope, as the journey to Rome was blocked by the Venetians. He proclaimed himself elected emperor in 1508 at Trento, with Pope Julius II later recognising it.

zh.t: 布列塔尼女公爵安妮与神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世通过代理人结婚
zh.s: 马克西米利安一世（1459年3月22日—1519年1月12日）自1486年起为罗马人民的国王，1508年起担任神圣罗马帝国皇帝，直至1519年去世。由于威尼斯人的阻挠，他无法前往罗马，因此从未由教宗加冕。1508年，他在特伦托自称当选皇帝，后来得到教宗儒略二世承认。

en.s: The Battle of Dreux was fought on 19 December 1562 between Catholics and Huguenots. The Catholics were led by Anne de Montmorency while Louis I, Prince of Condé led the Huguenots. Though commanders from both sides were captured, the French Catholics won the battle.

zh.s: 德勒战役于1562年12月19日爆发，交战双方是天主教徒与胡格诺派。天主教军由安妮·德·蒙莫朗西率领，胡格诺派由孔代亲王路易一世统率。双方指挥官均被俘，但最终由法国天主教军赢得战斗。

en.s: The siege of Arundel took place during the First English Civil War, from 19 December 1643 to 6 January 1644, when a Royalist garrison surrendered to a Parliamentarian army under Sir William Waller. At the end of 1642, South-East England was largely controlled by Parliament, with pockets of Royalist support in Hampshire and Kent.

zh.s: 阿伦德尔围城战发生于第一次英国内战期间，时间为1643年12月19日至1644年1月6日。保王派守军最终向威廉·沃勒爵士率领的议会军投降。1642年底，英格兰东南部大多由议会控制，但汉普郡和肯特郡仍有一些保王派据点。

en.s: The Battle of Brailov (Ukrainian: Битва під Браїловим, Polish: Bitwa pod Braiłowem) was the first battle of the Polish–Cossack–Tatar war that took place on 19 December 1666 between the joint Cossack-Tatar army led by Petro Doroshenko and the Polish-Lithuanian army led by Sebastian Machowski. It ended in a Cossack-Tatar victory with Machowski taken prisoner.

zh.s: 1666年12月19日，彼得罗·多罗申科率领哥萨克—鞑靼联军，与塞巴斯蒂安·马霍夫斯基率领的波兰—立陶宛军队交战。这是波兰—哥萨克—鞑靼战争的首场战斗，最终哥萨克—鞑靼联军获胜，马霍夫斯基被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Cádiz was fought on 18–19 December 1669 off Cádiz between the English Royal Navy warship HMS Mary Rose under Rear-admiral John Kempthorne, which was escorting several English merchantmen, and a squadron of seven Barbary corsairs operating out of the Regency of Algiers. The incident was recorded and drawn by the engraver Wenceslaus Hollar, with an engraving appearing in John Ogilby's 1670 work Africa.

zh.s: 加的斯海战于1669年12月18日至19日在加的斯附近海域发生。英国皇家海军“玛丽·罗斯”号战舰由约翰·肯普索恩少将指挥，负责护送数艘英国商船；途中遭遇来自阿尔及尔摄政区的七艘巴巴里海盗船。雕刻师温塞斯劳斯·霍拉尔记录并绘制了这起事件，相关版画后来收录于约翰·奥格尔比1670年的著作《非洲》。

en.s: The Battle of Sich took place between the Ottoman-Crimean army and the Zaporozhian Cossacks, during the Ottoman-Crimean campaign into the Sich, at night on 19 December 1674. Detailed description of this battle only appears in Velychko's chronicle.

zh.s: 1674年12月19日晚，奥斯曼—克里米亚联军在进攻西奇的战役中与扎波罗热哥萨克交战。关于这场战斗的详细记载只见于维利奇科的编年史。

en.t: The Great Swamp Fight, a pivotal battle in King Philip's War, gives the English settlers a bitterly won victory
en.s: The Great Swamp Massacre or the Great Swamp Fight was a crucial battle fought during King Philip's War between the colonial militia of New England and the Narragansett people in December 1675. It was fought near the villages of Kingston and West Kingston in the Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations.

zh.t: 大沼泽地之战：菲利普王战争中的关键战役，英格兰殖民者惨胜
zh.s: 大沼泽地大屠杀，也称大沼泽地之战，是菲利普王战争期间的一场关键战役，发生于1675年12月的新英格兰殖民民兵与纳拉甘西特人之间。战斗地点在罗得岛与普罗维登斯庄园殖民地的金斯敦和西金斯敦村附近。

en.t: Glorious Revolution: Williamite forces defeat Jacobites at Battle of Reading, forcing James II to flee England
en.s: The Glorious Revolution was the deposition of King James II in November 1688. He was replaced by his daughter Mary II and her Dutch husband, James's nephew William III of Orange. The two ruled as joint monarchs of England, Scotland, and Ireland until Mary's death in 1694, when William became ruler in his own right.

zh.t: 光荣革命：威廉派在雷丁战役击败詹姆斯党，迫使詹姆斯二世逃离英格兰
zh.s: 光荣革命是1688年11月废黜国王詹姆斯二世的事件。随后由他的女儿玛丽二世和荷兰执政者奥兰治的威廉三世（詹姆斯的外甥）取代他。两人共同统治英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰，直到玛丽于1694年去世，之后威廉独自执政。

en.t: Thomas Paine publishes one of a series of pamphlets in The Pennsylvania Journal entitled "The American Crisis"
en.s: Thomas Paine (born Thomas Pain, February 9, 1737 [O.S. January 29, 1736] – June 8, 1809; ) was an English-born American Founding Father, inventor, political philosopher, and statesman. He authored Common Sense (1776) and The American Crisis (1776–1783), two of the most influential pamphlets at the start of the American Revolution, and he helped to inspire the colonial era patriots in 1776 to declare independence from Great Britain.

zh.t: 托马斯·潘恩在《宾夕法尼亚杂志》发表《美国危机》系列小册子之一
zh.s: 托马斯·潘恩（出生名托马斯·佩恩，1737年2月9日〔旧历1736年1月29日〕—1809年6月8日）是出生于英格兰的美国开国元勋、发明家、政治哲学家和政治家。他写了《常识》（1776年）和《美国危机》（1776—1783年），这两本小册子在美国革命初期影响深远；1776年，他还帮助鼓舞北美殖民地爱国者宣布脱离英国独立。

en.s: Valley Forge was the winter encampment of the Continental Army, under the command of George Washington, during the Philadelphia campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The encampment, located in eastern Pennsylvania along the Schuylkill River, lasted approximately six months, from December 19, 1777, to June 19, 1778.

zh.s: 美国大陆军在乔治·华盛顿指挥下，于美国独立战争费城战役期间在福吉谷扎营过冬。营地位于宾夕法尼亚州东部的斯库尔基尔河沿岸，持续约六个月，从1777年12月19日到1778年6月19日。

en.t: William Pitt the Younger becomes the youngest Prime Minister of the United Kingdom at 24
en.s: William Pitt (28 May 1759 – 23 January 1806) was a British statesman who served as the last prime minister of Great Britain from 1783 until the Acts of Union 1800, and the first official prime minister of the United Kingdom from January 1801. He left office in March 1801, but served as prime minister again from 1804 until his death in 1806.

zh.t: 24岁的威廉·皮特成为英国最年轻的首相
zh.s: 威廉·皮特（1759年5月28日—1806年1月23日）是英国政治家。1783年至《1800年联合法案》通过前，他担任大不列颠首相；1801年1月起，他成为英国首任正式首相。同年3月离任，1804年再次出任首相，并一直任职至1806年去世。

en.s: The siege of Toulon (29 August – 19 December 1793) was fought at the French Mediterranean naval base of Toulon during the War of the First Coalition. It began after opponents of the radical Montagnard government, initially associated with the Federalist revolts, surrendered the port, its arsenal and much of the French Mediterranean Fleet to an Anglo-Spanish force.

zh.s: 土伦围城战从1793年8月29日持续至12月19日，是第一次反法同盟战争期间在法国地中海海军基地土伦展开的围城战。激进派山岳党政府的反对者起初与联邦主义起义有关联；他们向英西联军交出了港口、兵工厂和法国地中海舰队的大部分力量，围城战由此开始。

en.s: The action of 19 December 1796 was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought in the last stages of the Mediterranean campaign between two British Royal Navy frigates and two Spanish Navy frigates off the coast of Murcia. The British squadron was the last remaining British naval force in the Mediterranean, sent to transport the British garrison of Elba to safety under the command of Commodore Horatio Nelson.

zh.s: 1796年12月19日海战是法国大革命战争地中海战役末期的一场小规模海战，交战双方分别是两艘英国皇家海军护卫舰和两艘西班牙海军护卫舰，战场位于穆尔西亚海岸附近。英国分舰队是地中海仅存的一支英国海军力量，由准将霍雷肖·纳尔逊指挥，任务是护送厄尔巴岛的英国驻军转移至安全地带。

en.s: The Battle of Campichuelo was a skirmish that took place on 19 December 1810 when the military expedition sent by the Primera Junta crossed the Paraná River from Candelaria to Campichuelo de la Candelaria, where a Paraguayan outpost was positioned. The action ended without casualties from either side.

zh.s: 1810年12月19日，普里梅拉·胡恩塔派出的军事远征队从坎德拉里亚渡过巴拉那河，前往坎皮丘埃洛德拉坎德拉里亚。当地设有巴拉圭军哨所，双方发生小规模交战，最终无人伤亡。

en.s: In the Siege of Tarifa from 19 December 1811 to 5 January 1812, an Imperial French army under Jean François Leval laid siege to an Anglo-Spanish garrison led by Francisco Copons. Despite the advice of British Colonel John Byrne Skerrett to evacuate the town, Copons decided to hold out. Some wanted to evacuate to and defend the small island that was attached by a causeway from the town. Tarifa is located on Route 340 on the southernmost tip of Spain, or about 65 miles (105 km) southeast of Cadiz. The siege occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 塔里法围城战从1811年12月19日持续到1812年1月5日。让-弗朗索瓦·勒瓦尔率领法兰西帝国军队围攻由弗朗西斯科·科蓬斯指挥的英西联军守军。尽管英国上校约翰·伯恩·斯克雷特建议撤离城镇，科蓬斯仍决定坚守。一些人主张撤到通过堤道与城镇相连的小岛上防守。塔里法位于西班牙最南端的340号公路沿线，距加的斯东南约65英里（105公里）。这场围城战发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The Capture of Fort Niagara took place 19 December 1813 during the War of 1812 between Great Britain and the United States. The American garrison was taken by surprise, and the fort was captured in a night assault by a select force of British regular infantry.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间，英国和美国交战。1813年12月19日，美军守军遭到突袭，一支英国正规步兵精锐部队夜袭并攻占尼亚加拉堡。

en.s: A Christmas Carol. In Prose. Being a Ghost Story of Christmas, commonly known as A Christmas Carol, is a novella by Charles Dickens, first published in London by Chapman & Hall in 1843 and illustrated by John Leech. It recounts the story of Ebenezer Scrooge, an elderly miser who is visited by the ghost of his former business partner Jacob Marley and the spirits of Christmas Past, Present and Yet to Come.

zh.s: 《圣诞颂歌》是查尔斯·狄更斯创作的一部中篇小说，原名《圣诞颂歌：一则散文体鬼故事》，1843年由伦敦的查普曼与霍尔出版社首次出版，并由约翰·利奇绘制插图。小说讲述吝啬的老年商人埃比尼泽·斯克鲁奇遇见已故商业伙伴雅各布·马利的鬼魂，以及圣诞节过去、现在和未来三位精灵的故事。

en.s: The Battle of Pease River, also known as the Pease River Massacre or the Pease River fight, occurred on December 19, 1860, near present-day Margaret, Texas in Foard County, Texas, United States. The town is located between Crowell and Vernon within sight of the Medicine Mounds just outside present-day Quanah, Texas. A monument marks the site where a group of Comanche Indians were massacred by a detachment of Texas Rangers and militia under Ranger Captain "Sul" Ross.

zh.s: 皮斯河战役也称皮斯河大屠杀或皮斯河冲突，于1860年12月19日发生在美国得克萨斯州福尔德县、今玛格丽特附近。该镇位于克罗韦尔与弗农之间，靠近今夸纳以外的梅迪辛丘陵。当地纪念碑标记着事发地点：得克萨斯游骑兵和民兵分队在游骑兵队长“苏尔”·罗斯率领下，在此屠杀了一群科曼奇人。

en.s: The Skirmish at Blackwater Creek, also known as the Skirmish at Milford, was an American Civil War skirmish that took place in central Missouri on December 19, 1861, near present-day Valley City. It was a victory for the North.

zh.s: 黑水溪小冲突也称米尔福德小冲突，是美国内战期间的一场交战，于1861年12月19日在密苏里州中部、今瓦利城附近发生。北军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Jackson, also known as the Battle of Salem Cemetery, was fought on December 19, 1862, in Madison County, Tennessee, during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 杰克逊战役又称塞勒姆公墓战役，于1862年12月19日在美国内战期间发生于田纳西州麦迪逊县。

en.s: The Battle of Altamaha Bridge, also known as the Battle for the Doctortown Railroad Trestle, was an American Civil War engagement fought December 19, 1864, in Wayne County, Georgia, during Sherman's March to the Sea. The Confederate victory prevented Federal forces from destroying a vital railroad bridge during Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman's siege of Savannah, keeping open Confederate supply lines to the city.

zh.s: 阿尔塔马哈桥战役也称多克托敦铁路栈桥战役，是美国内战期间的一场交战，于1864年12月19日在佐治亚州韦恩县发生，属于谢尔曼向海进军的一部分。邦联军获胜，阻止联邦军摧毁一座重要铁路桥，保障了萨凡纳城的邦联补给线。

en.s: The 1871 Georgia gubernatorial special election was held on December 19, 1871, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia following the resignation of Governor Rufus Bullock. Democratic nominee and incumbent Speaker of the Georgia House of Representatives James Milton Smith ran unopposed and thus won the election.

zh.s: 佐治亚州州长卢弗斯·布洛克辞职后，该州于1871年12月19日举行特别选举。民主党候选人、当时的佐治亚州众议院议长詹姆斯·米尔顿·史密斯在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 1871 Canadian federal by-elections in British Columbia occurred in November and December 1871 to elect British Columbia's first members of Parliament following the province's entry into Canada. Five electoral districts were established to elect six members to the Canadian House of Commons.

en.s: The Battle of Little Dry Creek was a skirmish during Geronimo's War. Chiricahua Apache warriors were raiding in the Arizona and New Mexico border area when they ambushed a larger force of United States Army troops and Navajo Scouts near Pleasanton.

en.s: The Hopetoun Blunder was a political event during the federation of Australia which culminated in the appointment of Edmund Barton as the first prime minister of Australia. The 'blunder' refers to the decision of John Hope, 7th Earl of Hopetoun, the first governor-general of Australia, to commission the then-premier of New South Wales, Sir William Lyne, as prime minister to form an interim government for the period between federation on 1 January 1901 and a general election for the first parliament in March of 1901.

en.s: The Darr Mine disaster at Van Meter, Rostraver Township, Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, near Smithton, killed 239 men and boys on December 19, 1907. It ranks as the worst coal mining disaster in Pennsylvanian history. An inquiry carried out after the disaster determined that the blast was the result of miners carrying open lamps in an area cordoned off the previous day by the fire boss. The mine’s owner, the Pittsburgh Coal Company was not held responsible but abandoned the use of open lamps after the disaster.

zh.s: 1907年12月19日，宾夕法尼亚州史密顿附近的达尔煤矿发生灾难，239名男性矿工和男孩遇难。它是宾夕法尼亚州历史上最严重的煤矿灾难。事后调查认定，爆炸是因为矿工携带明火灯具进入矿区，而该区域前一天已被矿井安全主管封锁。矿主匹兹堡煤炭公司未被追究责任，但灾难发生后停止使用明火灯具。

en.s: During the 1908 Venezuelan coup d'état, General Juan Vicente Gómez took power on 19 December during the absence of President Cipriano Castro. en.s: The German phosgene attack of 19 December 1915 was the first use of phosgene gas against British troops by the German army. The gas attack took place at Wieltje, north-east of Ypres in Belgian Flanders on the Western Front in the First World War. German gas attacks on Allied troops had begun on 22 April 1915, during the Second Battle of Ypres using chlorine against French and Canadian units.

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 19 December 1931. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and 18 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Australian Labor Party led by Prime Minister of Australia James Scullin was defeated by the newly formed opposition United Australia Party--a merger of the Nationalist Party of Australia with several Labor dissidents led by Joseph Lyons, who became leader of the merged party. The UAP fought the election in the traditional non-Labor Coalition with the Country Party, led by Earle Page, but won enough seats to form a majority UAP government.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1931年12月19日举行联邦选举。众议院全部75个席位以及参议院36个席位中的18个席位改选。总理詹姆斯·斯卡林领导的执政澳大利亚工党败给了新成立的反对党澳大利亚联合党。该党由澳大利亚民族主义党与约瑟夫·莱昂斯领导的数名工党异议人士合并而成，莱昂斯成为联合党领袖。联合党与厄尔·佩奇领导的乡村党按传统非工党联盟参选，并赢得足够席位组建联合党多数政府。

en.t: BBC World Service begins broadcasting as the BBC Empire Service
en.s: The BBC World Service is a British public service broadcaster owned and operated by the BBC. It is the world's largest external broadcaster in terms of reception area, language selection and audience reach. It broadcasts radio news, speech and discussions in more than 40 languages to many parts of the world on analogue and digital shortwave platforms, internet streaming, podcasting, satellite, DAB, FM, LW and MW relays.

zh.t: BBC帝国服务开播，即后来的BBC世界服务
zh.s: BBC世界服务是英国公共广播机构，由英国广播公司（BBC）拥有并运营。按覆盖范围、语种和受众规模计算，它是全球最大的国际广播机构。它通过模拟和数字短波、网络直播、播客、卫星、数字音频广播、调频、长波和中波转播等方式，以40多种语言向世界许多地区播送新闻、谈话节目和讨论。

en.s: Early and indirect presidential elections were held in Finland in 1940 after President Kyösti Kallio resigned on 27 November following a stroke on 27 August. The 1937 electoral college was recalled and elected Prime Minister Risto Ryti, who received 288 of the 300 votes. Most other Finnish politicians considered Ryti a principled, unselfish, intelligent and patriotic man, who could lead Finland effectively enough during World War II.

zh.s: 1940年，芬兰提前举行间接总统选举。总统屈厄斯蒂·卡利奥于当年8月中风，随后于11月27日辞职。1937年选出的选举人团重新集会，选举总理里斯托·吕蒂为总统，他获得300票中的288票。芬兰多数政界人士认为，吕蒂正直、无私、聪明且爱国，足以在第二次世界大战期间有效领导芬兰。

en.t: John Amery, British Fascist, is executed at the age of 33 by the British Government for treason
en.s: John Amery (14 March 1912 – 19 December 1945) was a British fascist and Nazi collaborator during World War II. en.s: The Madiun Affair (Indonesian: Peristiwa Madiun, lit. en.s: The Indian annexation of Goa was the process in which the Republic of India annexed the Portuguese State of India, the then Portuguese Indian territories of Goa, Daman and Diu, starting with the armed action carried out by the Indian Armed Forces in December 1961. en.s: The December 1964 South Vietnamese coup took place before dawn on December 19, 1964, when the ruling military junta of South Vietnam led by General Nguyễn Khánh dissolved the High National Council (HNC) and arrested some of its members. The HNC was an unelected legislative-style civilian advisory body they had created at the request of the United States—South Vietnam's main sponsor—to give a veneer of civilian rule. The dissolution dismayed the Americans, particularly the ambassador, Maxwell D. Taylor, who engaged in an angry war of words with various generals including Khánh and threatened aid cuts.

zh.s: 1964年12月19日黎明前，由阮庆将军领导的南越执政军政府解散了最高国民委员会（HNC），并逮捕了部分委员。HNC是一个未经选举产生、类似立法机构的民间咨询组织，由军政府应美国要求设立，以营造实行文人统治的表象。美国是南越的主要支持者。解散委员会的做法令美国方面十分不满，尤其是大使麦克斯韦·泰勒；他与阮庆等多名将领激烈争执，并威胁削减援助。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 5 December 1965, with a second round on 19 December. They were the first direct presidential elections in the Fifth Republic and the first since the Second Republic in 1848. It had been widely expected that incumbent president Charles de Gaulle would be re-elected, but the election was notable for the unexpectedly strong performance of his left-wing challenger and future president François Mitterrand.

en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 19 December 1968 to elect the National Assembly and President. The first post-independence polls saw incumbent Kenneth Kaunda retain his post as president, whilst his United National Independence Party, the only party to field candidates in all 105 constituencies, won 81 of the 105 seats in the National Assembly. Voter turnout was 82.5% in the parliamentary election, but 87.1% in the presidential election. The only other contestants in the National Assembly elections were the Zambian African National Congress (73 candidates), and three independents.

en.t: Nelson Rockefeller is sworn in as U.S. vice president

en.s: The 2019–2020 northwestern Syria offensive, codenamed "Dawn of Idlib 2," was a military operation launched by the armed forces of the Syrian Arab Republic, Russia, Iran, Hezbollah and other allied militias against Syrian opposition and allied fighters of the Syrian National Army, Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham, Rouse the Believers Operations Room, the Turkistan Islamic Party, and other rebels during the Syrian civil war. en.s: The 2021-22 Khyber Pakhtunkhwa local elections were held in 17 districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan on 19 December 2021 and 31 March 2022. In the first phase of the election, the Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F) (JUI(F)) won 23 tehsil chairman positions while the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) won 16 tehsil chairman positions.
